text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(How did you find the business proposal I 
submitted the other day?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Please let me know anytime if there is 
anything I can improve on.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yup, transmission complete. Now, what else 
do I need to check—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Is it already this late...!? I've done 
it again............ *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushing herself too hard, Satono Diamond 
ended up staying up late...
